payload.title: calibrate_source_weights counts only feedback rows whose metadata.pressure_source names a pressure source, but record_operator_feedback has no metadata parameter and no producer writes the key, so every source's multiplier is exactly 1.0 and the branch reports nothing wrong
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/calibration_dials.py:45-55 (feedback_dial reads row['metadata']['pressure_source'] to build the pressure-source dial)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/calibration_dials.py:4-8 (the module records that no producer writes metadata.pressure_source: 0 of 245 labelled rows when measured)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:806-853 (record_operator_feedback accepts no metadata or pressure_source argument)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/calibrated_intelligence.py:95-148 (source calibration counts tp and fp per pressure_source dial only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pressure.py:247-258 (run_pressure scales each source weight by that multiplier)
payload.rule_violated: A calibration branch with no label producer is a mechanism that reads as working (zero labels gives multiplier 1.0 with no warning); ORPHAN-HIGH-627 wired the reader without a writer.
payload.notes: pressure.run_pressure calls calibrate_source_weights over every feedback row each cycle. Every row is attributed to a tool dial (feedback_dial falls through to tool_id) because none carries metadata.pressure_source, so counts per source are empty and each source's weight is its hand-set base times 1.0 forever. Reflection prints only movers, so the silence looks healthy while the Beta-Binomial source calibration that ORPHAN-HIGH-627 shipped never moves a weight. Close condition: Either a typed producer stamps the pressure source on the labelled rows (record_operator_feedback gains the field, set by the consensus and outcome producers) and a test asserts a source with fp greater than tp gets a multiplier below 1.0 in run_pressure, or the SOURCE_DIAL branch and calibrate_source_weights are deleted and a test pins that pressure weights equal SOURCE_WEIGHTS. Verified at origin/main d716541239.
